_meta.purpose: Lets the ACADEMIC arm of the 2026-09-04 multivocal protocol mark each retrieved record as already-dispositioned or novel against the 2026-09-02 branch. This file executes NO external query and retrieves nothing: it is derived entirely from two files already in the repository.

derived_from.state: amendment A16 stage-2 verdicts, 2026-09-03; these OVERRIDE the row above for the same record id

notes: Values are the 2026-09-02 branch primary disposition code, POST-amendment-A16.

'include' means the record is already in that corpus. X10 and X11 are CAPACITY GAPS, not eligibility determinations: a record carrying one is NOT settled and MAY legitimately be retrieved again by this branch.
'undecided' (7 records) is amendment A16's own residual: assessed at stage 2 and not settled at the depth reached.

X7 (244 records) is 'no persistent identifier' under the OLD protocol. Those records are candidates this branch may now admit, since the 2026-09-04 protocol drops the persistent-identifier requirement. They are the single clearest novelty stratum.
Coverage limit: only 6,923 of 8,813 records carry an identifier, so a record with no identifier in the old branch cannot be differenced by this index and must be differenced on title.
